# ffxf_vm_network (Data Source)

Reads network interfaces and public addresses assigned to a virtual machine.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_vm_network" "example" {
  vm_id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `ipv4` (Attributes List) IP addresses assigned to the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv4))
- `ipv6` (Attributes List) IP addresses assigned to the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ipv6))
- `ipv6_prefix` (String) Delegated IPv6 prefix, when available.
- `port_mbps` (Number) Network port speed in Mbps.
- `private` (Attributes List) Private networks (VPCs) attached to the VM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private))

<a id="nestedatt--ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP address.
- `gateway` (String) Address gateway, when provided.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Address prefix length, when provided.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary address.
- `rdns` (String) Reverse-DNS hostname, when configured.
- `version` (Number) IP version.


<a id="nestedatt--ipv6"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ipv6`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IP address.
- `gateway` (String) Address gateway, when provided.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Address prefix length, when provided.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary address.
- `rdns` (String) Reverse-DNS hostname, when configured.
- `version` (Number) IP version.


<a id="nestedatt--private"></a>
### Nested Schema for `private`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Private IP address.
- `configuration` (String) Address configuration mode.
- `name` (String) VPC name.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Private address prefix length.
- `vpc` (Number) VPC numeric ID.
